verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a real conversion API: Transfers v.3 replaces the legacy Quote API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion, with digest-based quote acceptance. Live quotes are also generated for payments, and fiat and stablecoin balances can be converted between each other. The pack does not document rates, a fee schedule (only partner markup fees) or settlement times, and does not explicitly cover stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion. Missing for 10: documented rate sourcing, documented fee schedule, documented settlement times, explicit stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, conversion is a first-class API — quotes and executed conversions between fiat and stablecoins (and between stablecoins) with documented rates, fees, and settlement times

citations.quote: The Transfers v.3 API replaces the legacy Quote API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion.
currency conversion is now a property of a transfer. Migrating to v.3 provides a single-field status model, digest-based quote acceptance, mandatory idempotency
For every payment, BVNK generates a live quote to be accepted by the customer and a unique blockchain address for the payment to be made to.
Use your fiat balance to send stablecoins, or fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat.
